input.title: Women's Christmas Capybara – I'm Not Stuck, I'm Decorated Crewneck Sweatshirt
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This Christmas capybara sweatshirt is for the woman who has spent half of December untangling string lights and wants everyone to know she is not stuck, she is decorated.

One unbothered capybara sits completely wrapped in a tangle of colorful string lights with a red ornament balanced on its head. I'M NOT STUCK. runs above it in heavy red slab letters and I'M DECORATED. below in green.

Pull it on for tree-trimming night, the office party and every holiday movie marathon. The lights stay on and the capybara stays calm. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex crewneck sweatshirt fit
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and waistband; no hood, no pockets
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 4 colors: White, Sand, Light Pink, Sport Grey

Questions

How does the crewneck fit?
The Women's Christmas Capybara crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. is a classic unisex sweatshirt in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one size for a roomier, layered look over a long sleeve shirt.

What is the fabric and how do I wash it?
It is an 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a ribbed crew neck, cuffs and waistband. Turn it inside out, wash cold with like colors, and tumble dry low so the Graphic Tees Co. print stays bright.

Is it a good Christmas gift?
Yes. It suits the capybara fan, the friend who always gets tangled in the lights and anyone who loves a funny holiday sweatshirt. To arrive before Christmas, order by about December 8. Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange if it does not fit.

What colors does it come in?
This Women's Christmas Capybara crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. comes in White, Sand, Sport Grey and Light Pink. The red and green lettering and the capybara read clearly on all four light colors, with the ink colors shown in each color's photo.

How long does shipping take?
Each sweatshirt is printed to order, so production takes a few days and then it ships free in the US on orders of $45 or more. For Christmas delivery, Graphic Tees Co. suggests ordering by about December 8, and tracking arrives by email.
